text: This is Coinnibal. | Coins that eat coins, | on Robinhood Chain.
Buy a ticket in $NIBAL, | from one to ten dollars. | That's your coin's value.
Eat smaller coins. | Run from *bigger* ones.
Alive at the bell? | You get *paid.*
The fee only touches profit, | and most of it *burns.* | So does half of every power-up.
The Coinnibal NFT collection. | Hold one: | half the fee, | the ten-dollar room, | cheaper power-ups.
